magical-bridge-playground.zh: 约8000平方米的围栏场地，无障碍分区、玩水区和遮阳。
magical-bridge-playground.en: An 8,000 m² fenced site with accessible play zones, water play and shade.

hamilton-lake-domain.zh: 大型湖畔游乐场，市政列有无障碍器材和无障碍厕所。
hamilton-lake-domain.en: A large lakeside playground with Council-listed accessible equipment and accessible toilets.

minogue-park-destination-playground.zh: 大型游乐场，儿童滑索、玩沙玩水、蹦床和滑板车道，设厕所。
minogue-park-destination-playground.en: A large playground with twin flying foxes, sand and water play, trampolines, scooter track and toilets.

tauhara-park-destination-playground.zh: 滑梯、儿童滑索和攀爬网，设遮阳、野餐桌和无障碍厕所。
tauhara-park-destination-playground.en: Slides, flying fox and climbing nets, with shade, picnic tables and accessible toilets.

hare-puke-park.zh: 适合低龄及较大儿童，有大型攀爬网、遮阳帆、滑板车道和厕所。
hare-puke-park.en: Play for younger and older children, with a large climbing net, shade sails, scooter track and toilets.
